name: claude-canvas
description: A rendered canvas beside your terminal that Claude Code pushes Markdown, LaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, charts, images and HTML pages into.

commands.title: Register the Claude Code plugin (canvas_push tool)

claudeCanvas.directory.description: The drop folder the canvas watches. Agents push cards by writing files into its feed/ subfolder; the Claude Code plugin reads the same path (override it there with CLAUDE_CANVAS_DIR).

claudeCanvas.autoOpen.description: Open the canvas panel when a card arrives while it is closed.

claudeCanvas.maxCards.description: Cards kept on the canvas; older ones move to history/.

claudeCanvas.defaultFrameHeight.description: Height in pixels of an HTML card's frame when the push gives none.
